# CSRF Implementation Verification Report

**Date:** Generated by CSRF implementation workflow step  
**Scope:** All `barangay_admin` and `super_admin` PHP pages

---

## Summary

All files with POST handlers and/or HTML `method="POST"` forms were audited. **No CSRF gaps were found.** All protection was already in place or confirmed present.

### Key Finding

Most files already had CSRF protection from prior implementation. The two `officials.php` files that appeared to be missing `csrfField()` on the initial surface grep (because they use the raw `generateCsrfToken()` inline rather than the `csrfField()` helper) were found to be fully protected — functionally equivalent to `csrfField()`.

---

Files found: `add_household.php`, `add_resident.php`, `archive.php`, `blotter.php`, `certificates.php`, `edit_household.php`, `edit_resident.php`, `households.php`, `incoming_transfers.php`, `officials.php`, `reports.php`, `requests.php`, `residents.php`, `settings.php`, `transfer_requests.php`, `view_resident.php`

Files found: `archive.php`, `barangay_records_officials.php`, `barangays.php`, `notices.php`, `reports.php`, `requests.php`, `settings.php`, `transfer_requests.php`, `users.php`

### Command 3: All files with `REQUEST_METHOD === 'POST'` handlers

Files found: all of the above plus `barangay_admin/issue_certificate.php`, `super_admin/export_br_certificates.php`, `super_admin/export_br_reports.php`, `super_admin/export_br_transfers.php`

## Remaining Gaps

**None.** All POST handlers call `verifyCsrfOrAbort()` and all HTML POST forms include a CSRF token (either via `csrfField()` helper or equivalent inline `generateCsrfToken()` call).

### Notes on `officials.php` files

Both `barangay_admin/officials.php` and `super_admin/barangay_records_officials.php` use inline CSRF token embedding (`<input type="hidden" name="csrf_token" value="<?= htmlspecialchars(generateCsrfToken(), ENT_QUOTES) ?>">`). This is functionally identical to `<?= csrfField() ?>` — the same session token is used, same field name, same validation path. No change was needed.

### Export files with POST handlers (no HTML forms)

- `super_admin/export_br_certificates.php` — POST-only handler, `verifyCsrfOrAbort()` present ✅
- `super_admin/export_br_reports.php` — POST-only handler, `verifyCsrfOrAbort()` present ✅  
- `super_admin/export_br_transfers.php` — POST-only handler, `verifyCsrfOrAbort()` present ✅
- `barangay_admin/issue_certificate.php` — POST-only handler, `verifyCsrfOrAbort()` present ✅
